title: Connect an email account
intro: Read and answer, from Mail, the messages of an account you already have (Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo…). New mail arrives on its own and replies go out through that account, with your address.
outlookSoon: Hotmail and Outlook.com only accept Microsoft sign-in, which is coming soon. For now, connect another provider.

steps.gmail: In Google, turn on 2-Step Verification and create an app password in Google Account → Security → App passwords. Google Workspace accounts may have this blocked by the admin.
steps.icloud: In your Apple Account, go to Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords and create one for MepMail.
steps.yahoo: In Yahoo, go to Account Security → Generate app password and create one for MepMail.
steps.zoho: In Zoho, go to Security → App Passwords and create one for MepMail. IMAP must be on in Zoho Mail settings.
steps.imap: Use the IMAP (port 993) and SMTP (465 or 587) servers your provider gives. If the account has 2-step verification, create an app password.

passwordHint: Stored encrypted and only used to fetch and send your mail. It is not the account's normal password.
label: Name shown in Mail
connected: {address} connected. Messages from the last 30 days are arriving.
privacy: MepMail only reads this account's Inbox and never deletes or marks anything at the provider.

errors.provider_unavailable: That provider can't be connected here yet.
errors.invalid_server: Check the servers: they must be public names (like imap.example.com).
errors.imap_login: The provider refused the sign-in. Check the address and the app password (not the account's normal password).
errors.imap_network: Couldn't reach the IMAP server. Check the server and that IMAP is on for the account.
errors.smtp_login: Reading worked, but sending refused the password. Check the username and app password.
errors.smtp_network: Reading worked, but the SMTP server couldn't be reached. Check the server and port.
errors.conflict: That account is already connected on this team, or the address is already a Mail mailbox.
errors.forbidden: You can't connect accounts on this team.
errors.generic: Couldn't connect right now. Try again.
errors.limit: You've connected the most external accounts allowed (3). Disconnect one to connect another.

status.firstSync: First sync in progress: messages from the last 30 days are arriving.
status.syncedAt: Synced {when}. New messages arrive every 2 minutes.
status.authFailed: The provider refused the app password (it may have been deleted, or the account password changed). Create a new app password and paste it below.
status.syncError: Couldn't sync right now. We'll try again in a few minutes.
status.storageFull: This account reached 1 GiB of copies in Mail and stopped syncing. Delete old messages here to free space; nothing changes at the provider.
status.replaced: Password updated. The account syncs again now.
status.syncRequested: Sync requested. New messages arrive in a moment.
status.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {address}? The copies in Mail are deleted; nothing changes in the original account.

errors.imap_login: The provider refused that password. Check it's a new app password.
errors.smtp_login: Reading accepted it, but sending refused that password.
errors.imap_network: Couldn't reach the IMAP server right now.
errors.smtp_network: Couldn't reach the SMTP server right now.
errors.generic: Couldn't save right now. Try again.
